description: Free!  I AM FREE!  I am free to gather strength, hidden from my captors.  For if they faced me now they would surely overpower and again imprison me.
But in time I will confront the giants, and they will regret their wardship of me!
You are a noble ally, <name>.  I will need your help again in time.  When I am ready, I will need you to summon me to the surface
Speak with Zaruk in Hammerfall.  He knows how I can be summoned.
completion: Welcome, <class>. The Lady has informed me of your coming, and if we are to bring her back to the surface then we have much to discuss...
